purpose: Fill missing Kandarin regional skilling unlocks not fully covered by progression-enrichment-regional-skilling-2026-07-25, gaps-2026-07-26, or outfits-2026-07-25: Fishing Guild and Deep Sea Fishing method detail, Piscatoris, Hall of Memories / Memorial to Guthix, Ourania altar, Seers' Village infrastructure and headband, Barbarian Outpost Agility, Catherby / Ardougne farm and Master Farmer seed routes, Elemental Workshop, and cobalt skillchompa catch-site geography. Does not re-author existing ids (deep-sea-fishing-hub, farmers-market-master-farmer, tavias-fishing-rod, skillchompa-supply, skillchompas, gnome-restaurant-sous-chef).

policy.region_rule: region_hint marks where the unlock or activity lives in the current planner taxonomy. region_hints marks a cross-region chain. required_regions is only used when both regions are needed for a full stack, not for dual dig-site claims. Quest auto-completion and League-specific overrides must be applied separately.
policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise unlocks that materially change self-sufficient progression, training throughput, supply access, or tool progression. Do not mirror every shop item.
policy.rate_rule: Do not promote stale XP/hour figures. Training rates belong in training datasets; this file records unlock state and effects.
policy.exclusion_rule: Livid Farm is on Lunar Isle (Fremennik), not Kandarin — do not assign it here. Crystal skillchompa wild catches remain Tirannwn pressure; only cobalt (and related Kandarin geography) is claimed as Kandarin supply.

activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Kandarin unlock. Pair with Deep Sea Fishing hub methods for high-level Fishing planning.

activity_additions.league_treatment: All methods sit behind Kandarin hub access. Prefer method unlocks over stale XP/hour tables.

activity_additions.notes: Official Equilibrium Kandarin area list includes Hall of Memories; the Memorial is the surface site above it in the Piscatoris Hunter area. Engram collection is global geography but the permanent buff hub and Hall entrance are Kandarin-sited. High-value buffs for skilling planning include Ethereal Connection (spring duration), Wisp Herder, Fairy Fire, Argento's Kindness, Stored Power (bottled Guthixian Cache), and memory-shard generators from Hunter/Farming/Thieving. Shared Knowledge is effectively obsolete after divine-location removal.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Site is Kandarin. Individual engram pickup locations may require other regions — mark cross-region pressure per engram rather than blocking the whole D&D.

activity_additions.name: Ourania Runecrafting Altar (ZMI)
activity_additions.location: Ourania Cave, west of the Battlefield / south of West Ardougne
requirements: No talisman or specific Runecrafting level to craft
Pure essence (or abyssal runic synapses for the synapse path)
unlocks: Random elemental and catalytic runes at 1.5x normal rune XP (post 29 September 2025 rebalance)
No multiple-runes-per-essence from level gates; Ardougne cloak 2+ roughly +15% rune output without extra XP
Eniola bank for 20 runes of any type
Safe long path or short combat path to the altar

activity_additions.notes: Wiki marks Ourania as Kandarin Equilibrium content. Major self-sufficient Runecrafting training and mixed-rune supply. XP multiplier was reduced from 2x to 1.5x when Abyss boosts began applying (29 September 2025). Ourania Teleport (71 Magic, Lunar spellbook) is the classic access path and pressures Lunar Diplomacy / Fremennik when valuing convenience, but spirit trees and other Kandarin teleports also reach the area.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Altar is Kandarin. Lunar Ourania Teleport may be Fremennik-gated; banked non-Lunar access routes still exist.
